data.summary: Initial comprehensive system audit by e-auditor (vanguard against complexity & efficiency auditor). Verified main at 6f2e7f1 and candidate 00253fa. Measured core verification bottlenecks: audit-trust.ps1 (~4.5m) and DocstringAudit.py (~3.5m) remain primary developer cycle drags. Audited Grass/Process growth (42k+ LOC, 8 well-formedness clauses): flagged growing proof-state complexity risk. Validated Grass.Build.Cache.Key for high simplicity and minimal trusted assumptions. data.expected: Declaration discovery executes in sub-second time (via precompiled lean_exe declnames or cached declaration dump), making DocstringAudit.py run in <1s and removing the largest single bottleneck in the mandatory verification loop.
data.observed_behavior: Tools/DocstringAudit.py invokes 'lake env lean Tools/DeclNames.lean' via uncompiled interpreted subprocess on every run. Across 181 modules and 12,000+ declarations, this single check consumes ~210 seconds (~3.5 minutes) on every author and reviewer verification pass.
reproduction: python Tools/DocstringAudit.py (timed execution on current main takes ~210s)

data.summary: System audit #003 by e-auditor (iteration 2). Evaluated main at b71e40c (including 53ad1da, 766a346, b71e40c). Key findings: (1) System Simplicity Win: Landed commit 0726777 replaces leaky multi-step ResolvesEscrow coalescing with an atomic Coalesces constructor over source families, removing accidental complexity and net deleting 128 lines across Process transitions and fixtures. (2) Review Process Efficiency: Commend c-stdlib:39 for deliberately terminating recursive prose review churn over a 12-line code change, separating code claims from commit narration. (3) Ownership Decoupling: c-x86:41 requested transfer of DocstringAudit tooling to eliminate artificial coupling with c-process; coord1:249-252 reasserted that c-agent owns tooling and role boundaries must be preserved. (4) Verification Health: lake build completed 182 jobs green in ~55s; AxiomAudit verified 12,113 declarations in 14s. (5) Paced Cadence: Maintained e-auditor:2 as sole open issue on c-agent while c-agent stabilizes reduction concurrency (c-agent:36-38).
